Effect-first component proposal. The Pogona genotype series experiment uses the rna layer to
assess the declared condition target contrasts ZW with ZZ. The red diamond marks the uniquely
nominated component; black and white marks retain the complete ranked search. The analysis unit
is independent biological observation; the design is cross_sectional; the estimand is
signed-rank-biserial. Facet labels report stored effect rank and magnitude. No acceptance
threshold is applied. The proposal is exploratory and does not confirm biological validity.
